title: UPI Cashback

examples.explanation: 5 can be made as 5, 2 + 2 + 1, 2 + 1 + 1 + 1, or 1 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 1. Order doesn't matter, so 1 + 2 + 2 is the same as 2 + 2 + 1.
Vouchers of 2 can only make even amounts.

hints: Counting ordered sequences is easier than counting unordered ones, and gives the wrong answer here. How can you make sure each combination is counted once?
Fix an order on the voucher values and decide the vouchers one value at a time. Let ways[x] be the number of ways to make x using only the values considered so far.
Adding value c: ways[x] += ways[x − c], for x going upwards from c. Going upwards lets the same value be used many times. Take everything modulo 10⁹ + 7.
